thread:
Priya (SecEng): quick heads-up — vuln triage found a high-severity openssl/libssl CVE in the current base-image (v2026-02). Need coordinated plan: rebuild images, signing flow, RBAC for signer SA, and audit retention.
Sam (EngInfra): timeline? can we do a rolling patch or must we rebuild full base?
Priya (SecEng): rebuild full base preferred (config + patched libs). We should do a canary image push -> smoke tests -> gradual cutover. Target window: next Tue 02:00–06:00 UTC.
Marcus (Runtime): re: signing — current image-signer SA uses a KMS envelope key. We'll need to grant decrypt/sign permissions to the pipeline SA temporarily. Also need to rotate the cosign key after rollout.
Olivia (SRE): audit requirements from compliance: 365d retention for signing events and 90d for runtime access logs. Who will push logs to our SIEM?
Priya (SecEng): Olivia can we stream KMS audit + image registry events to Splunk? We need immutable logs for any key usage and image publish.
Olivia (SRE): yes — will add ingestion rule and retention. Need exact log path names. Marcus/ Sam, please provide the KMS key resource ID and registry topic.
Sam (EngInfra): KMS key: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/image-signing/cryptoKeys/redwood-img-signer. Registry events go to projects/redwood-prod/topics/image-publish.
Priya (SecEng): RBAC change: request to add iam binding so artifact-pipeline@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com gets roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner on that key. Also allow read-only access to registry write-token secret.
Marcus (Runtime): propose ephemeral signer role instead of perm binding — create a short-lived KSA token minted by OIDC for the pipeline during the rollout window. That reduces blast radius.
Sam (EngInfra): OIDC flow is fine but needs infra work. If we go ephemeral, we should script creation with TTL. I can add a Cloud Build step to mint temporary creds.
Priya (SecEng): good. For emergency patching (incident mode) we should have a pre-approved emergency RBAC playbook to expedite signing — include list of approvers.
Olivia (SRE): add me and Priya as approvers. Also: we must revoke old images from the allowlist after rollout. How do we enforce runtime rejection?
Marcus (Runtime): runtime image policy supports signed-image allowlist + image digest denylist. We'll add new signer key fingerprint to allowlist and expire the old one. During canary, runtime accepts both, then after 24h we flip to only new key.
Priya (SecEng): signing command for reference (cosign + KMS envelope):

```bash
# sign with cosign using KMS-backed key
cosign sign --key k8s://artifact-pipeline/image-signer-secret gcr.io/redwood-prod/base:v2026-03
```

Priya (SecEng): Also add an automated scan in the pipeline (trivy) and break the build on high sev findings. Example:

```bash
trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 gcr.io/redwood-prod/base:v2026-03
```

Sam (EngInfra): note: registry policy will reject unsigned images for prod namespace. For the canary tag we allow unsigned to test, then require signature for promote.
Marcus (Runtime): we should also update admission controller to log all signature verification failures to a separate alerting channel.
Olivia (SRE): I'll make an alert (pager) for verification failures > 5 in 15m. Who owns on-call during rollout?
Priya (SecEng): SecEng owns the security triage, Runtime owns rollout automation, SRE owns alerts. I'll put a rotation on the calendar.
Sam (EngInfra): one more RBAC nuance — the KMS key currently has an IAM policy bound to a team-managed group. We'll need to add the pipeline SA or the short-lived principal. I'll raise a PR for the iam_policy.yaml.
Priya (SecEng): action items: 1) Sam: PR for IAM change + optional OIDC minting step (due EOD Fri). 2) Marcus: update admission controller + allowlist plan (due Mon). 3) Olivia: SIEM ingestion + alert (due Mon). 4) Priya: prepare emergency RBAC playbook & approver list (due Fri).
Marcus (Runtime): sign-off checklist for deployment: build -> trivy -> cosign sign -> push canary -> smoke tests -> update allowlist -> cutover. Keep deploy-bot notified.
deploy-bot: noted — will post status updates during the window and create a rollback marker if smoke fails. :white_check_mark:
Priya (SecEng): thanks all — I'll open a tracking ticket and link it here. Ping me if you need expedited approvals. :lock:
Sam (EngInfra): small ask — can we tag images with git sha and a rebuild metadata label so we can trace back?
Marcus (Runtime): yes, add label: org.redwood.rebuild_sha and org.redwood.rebuild_time.
Olivia (SRE): copying compliance — they'll want a short summary after cutover.
Priya (SecEng): closing thread for now — will post ticket link shortly.
